chapters.title: Chaat
chapters.deck: Street food from the lanes around the Golden Temple: crisp, tangy, sweet and cold all in one bite.

items.name: Pani Puri
items.desc: Hollow, paper-thin puris you fill with spiced potato and tangy mint-tamarind water, then eat in one cold, crackling burst.

items.name: Papdi Chaat
items.desc: Crisp wheat wafers under chilled yoghurt, sweet tamarind and green chutney, scattered with sev and a pinch of chaat masala.

items.name: Sweet Potato Chaat
items.desc: Roasted sweet potato tossed with lime, black salt and roasted cumin. Smoky, sweet and sharp at the same time.

items.name: Dahi Puri
items.desc: Little puris brimming with potato and chickpeas, drowned in cool sweet yoghurt and drizzled with both chutneys.

items.name: Samosa Chaat
items.desc: A crushed hot samosa smothered in chole, yoghurt and chutneys. Crunchy, saucy, and gone too fast.

items.name: Dahi Bhalla
items.desc: Soft lentil dumplings soaked until they melt, served in cold whipped yoghurt with tamarind and roasted cumin.

items.name: Bhalla Papdi Chaat
items.desc: The best of both: pillowy bhallas and crisp papdi together under yoghurt, chutney and sev.

items.name: Samosa
items.desc: Golden, flaky pastry folded around potato and peas warmed with cumin and green chilli. Served with tamarind chutney.

items.name: Aloo Tikki Chaat
items.desc: Crisp-edged potato patties griddled golden, then topped with chole, yoghurt, chutneys and a snap of raw onion.

chapters.title: Vegetarian Entrée
chapters.deck: Paneer and soya chap, marinated and kissed by the tandoor's fire.

items.name: Tandoori Paneer Tikka
items.desc: Thick cubes of paneer in a red yoghurt marinade, charred at the edges with peppers and onion. Smoky outside, soft within.

items.name: Malai Paneer Tikka
items.desc: Paneer folded into cream, cheese and cardamom, then roasted until just golden. Mild, rich and melting.

items.name: Achari Paneer Tikka
items.desc: Paneer in a tangy pickle marinade of mustard, fennel and nigella seeds. A bright, punchy kick from the tandoor.

items.name: Mushroom Tikka
items.desc: Plump mushrooms soaked in spiced yoghurt and roasted until juicy, with a smoky char on every cap.

items.name: Tandoori Soya Chap Tikka
items.desc: Meaty soya chap in a fiery tandoori marinade, blistered over the coals. A Punjabi street favourite.

items.name: Malai Soya Chap
items.desc: Soya chap bathed in cream, cashew and white pepper. Have it dry off the skewer or in a silky gravy.

items.name: Achari Soya Chap
items.desc: Soya chap tossed in tangy pickling spices and roasted until the edges crisp and caramelise.

items.name: Anjeer Paneer Tikka
items.desc: Paneer filled with sweet fig and nuts, gently spiced and roasted. A soft sweetness meets the smoke.

chapters.title: Momo
chapters.deck: Hand-folded dumplings, five ways.

items.name: Veg Momo
items.options: Steamed, fried, chilli, jhol or tandoori
items.desc: Delicate dumplings packed with finely chopped vegetables and ginger, served with a fiery tomato-chilli chutney.

items.name: Chicken Momo
items.options: Steamed, fried, chilli, jhol or tandoori
items.desc: Juicy minced chicken with garlic and spring onion inside a soft, pleated wrapper. Try them jhol, in a warm sesame-tomato broth.

chapters.title: Indo-Chinese, Vegetarian
chapters.deck: The wok-tossed food every Punjabi grows up craving: hot, glossy and loud with garlic.

items.name: Veg Noodles
items.desc: Noodles flash-tossed in a smoking wok with crunchy vegetables and soy. Go chilli garlic or Schezwan for more fire.

items.name: Chilli Paneer
items.desc: Crisp paneer tossed with capsicum, onion and green chilli in a glossy, sticky soy-chilli sauce.

items.name: Chilli Mushroom
items.desc: Battered mushrooms fried crisp, then thrown in the wok with garlic, chilli and spring onion.

items.name: Chilli Gobhi
items.desc: Crunchy cauliflower florets coated in a sweet, hot and tangy chilli glaze.

items.name: Paneer 65
items.desc: Bite-sized paneer in a fiery red batter, fried crisp and tossed with curry leaves and green chilli.

items.name: Soya Chap 65
items.desc: Soya chap pieces in a spicy, crackling coating, finished with curry leaves, or in Schezwan sauce.

items.name: Veg Manchurian
items.desc: Soft vegetable dumplings in a dark, garlicky soy gravy with ginger and spring onion.

items.name: Gobhi Manchurian
items.desc: Crisp cauliflower in a tangy Manchurian sauce that clings to every floret.

items.name: Honey Chilli Potato
items.desc: Crackling potato fingers glazed in honey and chilli, finished with toasted sesame. Sweet heat you cannot stop eating.

chapters.title: Indo-Chinese, Non-Vegetarian
chapters.deck: Chicken from the wok, with all the fire.

items.name: Chilli Chicken
items.desc: Crisp chicken tossed with capsicum, onion and green chilli in a hot, glossy soy-garlic sauce.

items.name: Chicken Noodles
items.desc: Wok-tossed noodles with tender chicken and crunchy vegetables. Add egg, or turn up the heat with Schezwan.

chapters.title: Non-Vegetarian Entrée
chapters.deck: Kebabs and tikkas straight off the skewer, smoky and still sizzling.

items.name: Tandoori Chicken Tikka
items.desc: Boneless chicken in yoghurt, Kashmiri chilli and garam masala, charred in the tandoor until smoky and juicy.

items.name: Malai Chicken Tikka
items.desc: Chicken in a mild marinade of cream, cheese and cardamom. Tender, buttery and gently smoked.

items.name: Tandoori Chicken
items.desc: The classic: chicken on the bone, deep red with spice, roasted until the skin blisters. Served with mint chutney and lemon.

items.name: Tandoori Lamb Cutlets
items.desc: Lamb cutlets marinated in ginger, garlic and warm spice, seared over the coals and pink at the bone.

items.name: Seekh Kebab
items.desc: Minced meat with fresh coriander, ginger and green chilli, pressed onto skewers and roasted until it drips.

items.name: Chapli Kebab
items.desc: Flat, crisp-edged minced patties studded with coriander seed, pomegranate and chilli, from the North-West Frontier.

items.name: Tangri Kebab
items.desc: Chicken drumsticks in a rich spiced yoghurt, roasted until the meat falls from the bone.

items.name: Blanket Kebab
items.desc: Seekh kebab wrapped in a thin blanket of egg and finished on the grill. Soft, smoky and generous.

chapters.title: Seafood Entrée
chapters.deck: Fish and prawns, Amritsar's other great love.

items.name: Tandoori Fish
items.desc: A whole fillet in ajwain and chilli marinade, roasted in the tandoor until flaky, with a lemony char.

items.name: Tandoori Fish Tikka
items.desc: Chunks of firm fish in mustard oil and spice, skewered and smoked over the coals.

items.name: Tandoori Prawn
items.desc: Juicy prawns in a garlicky red marinade, charred quickly so they stay sweet and tender.

items.name: Amritsari Fish
items.desc: Amritsar's famous fry: fish in a crisp gram-flour and ajwain batter, sprinkled with chaat masala and lemon.

items.name: Butter Garlic Prawn
items.desc: Prawns tossed in foaming butter, plenty of garlic and a little chilli. Mop it up with naan.

chapters.title: Vegetarian Mains
chapters.deck: Slow pots, butter and lentils: the heart of a Punjabi table.

items.name: Dal Makhani
items.desc: Black lentils and kidney beans simmered low and slow, finished with butter and cream. Velvety, smoky and deeply comforting.

items.name: Dal Tadka
items.desc: Yellow lentils finished with a sizzling tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic and red chilli.

items.name: Paneer Tikka Butter Masala
items.desc: Smoky tandoor-roasted paneer in a silky tomato and butter gravy, finished with fenugreek and cream.

items.name: Kadai Paneer
items.desc: Paneer, capsicum and onion tossed in an iron kadai with freshly pounded coriander seed and chilli.

items.name: Shahi Paneer
items.desc: A royal, gently sweet gravy of cashew, cream and cardamom, holding soft cubes of paneer.

items.name: Paneer Bhurji
items.desc: Fresh paneer crumbled into onion, tomato and green chilli, cooked until soft and fragrant. Best with hot paratha.

items.name: Malai Kofta
items.desc: Melt-in-the-mouth paneer and potato dumplings in a creamy, mildly spiced cashew gravy.

items.name: Palak Paneer
items.desc: Paneer in a smooth, bright spinach purée with garlic and a swirl of cream.

items.name: Sarson Ka Saag
items.desc: Mustard greens and spinach slow-cooked until silky, finished with white butter. The taste of a Punjabi winter.

items.name: Amritsari Chole
items.desc: Dark, tangy chickpeas cooked with tea leaves, dried pomegranate and a deep blend of roasted spices.

items.name: Soya Chap Masala
items.desc: Soya chap in a robust onion-tomato masala, rich enough to stand up to any naan.

chapters.title: Non-Vegetarian Mains
chapters.deck: The curries people cross the city for.

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.desc: Tandoor-smoked chicken in a velvety tomato, butter and cream gravy, with a whisper of fenugreek.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
items.desc: Charred chicken tikka in a bold, spiced onion-tomato masala with peppers.

items.name: Kadai Chicken
items.desc: Chicken cooked hard and fast in an iron kadai with capsicum, crushed coriander seed and dried red chilli.

items.name: Rara Chicken
items.desc: A Punjabi double-chicken curry: tender pieces in a thick gravy of spiced minced chicken. Rich and hearty.

items.name: Goat Masala
items.desc: Goat on the bone, cooked slowly in onion, ginger and whole spices until it falls apart.

chapters.title: Amritsari Special
chapters.deck: The dishes our name was made for.

items.name: Amritsari Special Chole Bhature
items.desc: Puffed, golden bhature torn open over dark, tangy Amritsari chole, with pickled onion and green chilli.

items.name: Haddi Wala Murga
items.desc: Chicken on the bone, dhaba-style, cooked in a rustic, peppery onion gravy until the meat slips free.

items.name: Kali Mirch Chicken
items.desc: Chicken in a creamy gravy built on freshly cracked black pepper. Warm, aromatic and quietly fiery.

items.name: Egg Bhurji
items.desc: Soft-scrambled eggs with onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander, the way Amritsar's night stalls make it.

chapters.title: Breads
chapters.deck: Slapped against the clay wall of the tandoor and brought to the table blistered and hot.

items.name: Plain Roti
items.desc: Whole-wheat bread baked in the tandoor, lightly charred and soft.

items.name: Plain Naan
items.desc: Soft, pillowy leavened bread with a blistered, golden crust.

items.name: Butter Naan
items.desc: Hot naan brushed generously with melting butter.

items.name: Garlic Naan
items.desc: Naan scattered with chopped garlic and coriander, buttered straight from the tandoor.

items.name: Cheese Naan
items.desc: Naan filled with molten cheese that stretches with every tear.

items.name: Cheese Garlic Naan
items.desc: Molten cheese inside, garlic and butter on top.

items.name: Cheese Chilli Naan
items.desc: Cheese naan with a kick of green chilli folded through.

items.name: Plain Lachha Paratha
items.desc: Flaky, layered whole-wheat paratha that pulls apart in buttery rings.

items.name: Methi Lachha Paratha
items.desc: Layered paratha with dried fenugreek leaves, earthy and fragrant.

items.name: Pudina Lachha Paratha
items.desc: Layered paratha finished with crushed dried mint. Cool and aromatic.

items.name: Green Chilli Lachha Paratha
items.desc: Flaky layers laced with fresh green chilli for a clean, sharp heat.

items.name: Red Chilli Lachha Paratha
items.desc: Layered paratha dusted with red chilli flakes. Warm, smoky heat.

items.name: Masala Lachha Paratha
items.desc: Flaky paratha sprinkled with our house spice mix and butter.

items.name: Makki di Roti
items.desc: Rustic cornmeal flatbread, crisp at the edges. Made to be eaten with sarson ka saag and white butter.

items.name: Missi Roti
items.desc: Gram-flour and wheat bread with onion, ajwain and chilli. Nutty and full of flavour.

items.name: Nutella Naan
items.desc: Hot naan filled with warm, melting Nutella. Dessert disguised as bread.

chapters.title: Kulchas & Stuffed Naans
chapters.deck: Amritsar's pride: crisp, layered bread stuffed and baked against the tandoor wall.

items.name: Amritsari Special Kulcha
items.desc: Crisp, flaky layers stuffed with spiced potato and onion, crowned with butter. Served with chole, chutney and onion.

items.name: Aloo Kulcha
items.desc: Kulcha filled with potato, green chilli, pomegranate seed and coriander.

items.name: Paneer Kulcha
items.desc: Kulcha stuffed with crumbled, lightly spiced paneer. Soft inside, crackling outside.

items.name: Gobhi Kulcha
items.desc: Kulcha filled with grated cauliflower, ginger and warm spice.

items.name: Mix Kulcha
items.desc: Potato, paneer, cauliflower and onion together in one generous, buttery kulcha.

items.name: Chicken Tikka Kulcha
items.desc: Smoky chopped chicken tikka baked inside a crisp kulcha.

items.name: Lamb Keema Naan
items.desc: Naan stuffed with spiced minced lamb, baked until the edges crisp and the filling is juicy.

items.name: Chicken Keema Naan
items.desc: Naan filled with spiced minced chicken, ginger and coriander.

chapters.title: Biryani
chapters.deck: Long-grain basmati layered with spice and sealed until fragrant.

items.name: Veg Biryani
items.desc: Basmati layered with vegetables, saffron, fried onion and whole spices. Served with raita.

items.name: Chicken Biryani
items.desc: Spiced chicken and saffron basmati cooked together, so every grain carries the flavour. Served with raita.

items.name: Paneer Biryani
items.desc: Paneer in a spiced masala layered with fragrant basmati and mint. Served with raita.

items.name: Goat Biryani
items.desc: Tender goat on the bone layered with basmati, browned onion and warm spice. Served with raita.

items.name: Soya Chap Biryani
items.desc: Spiced soya chap layered through aromatic basmati. Served with raita.

chapters.title: Rice
chapters.deck: To soak up every last spoon of gravy.

items.name: Plain Rice
items.desc: Steamed long-grain basmati, light and fluffy.

items.name: Jeera Rice
items.desc: Basmati tossed with cumin seeds toasted in ghee.

items.name: Peas Pulao
items.desc: Basmati cooked with green peas and whole spices.

items.name: Lemon Rice
items.desc: Bright, tangy rice with lemon, mustard seed and curry leaves.

items.name: Veg Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-fried rice with crunchy vegetables and soy.

items.name: Egg Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-fried rice with scrambled egg and spring onion.

items.name: Chicken Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-fried rice with tender chicken, egg and vegetables.

items.name: Paneer Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-fried rice with paneer and crisp vegetables.

chapters.title: Sides
chapters.deck: Cool yoghurt to calm the fire.

items.name: Raita
items.desc: Whipped yoghurt with roasted cumin and a pinch of salt.

items.name: Boondi Raita
items.desc: Cool yoghurt with tiny crisp gram-flour pearls that soften as you eat.

items.name: Cucumber Raita
items.desc: Yoghurt with grated cucumber and mint. Cooling and fresh.

chapters.title: Salad
chapters.deck: A crunch of something raw.

items.name: Onion Salad
items.desc: Sliced red onion with lemon, green chilli and chaat masala, as every Punjabi table has it.

items.name: Mix Salad
items.desc: Cucumber, tomato, onion and carrot with lemon and a pinch of salt.

chapters.title: Combos
chapters.deck: A full Punjabi plate, put together for you.

items.name: Kulcha Combo
items.desc: One Amritsari kulcha with chole, chutney, raita, pickle and salad.

items.name: Saag Combo
items.desc: Sarson ka saag with two makki di roti, raita, pickle and salad.

items.name: Paneer Combo
items.desc: Paneer tikka butter masala with two naan, raita and salad.

items.name: Dal Combo
items.desc: Dal tadka with rice, two roti, raita and salad.

items.name: Goat Curry Combo
items.desc: Goat curry with two naan and salad.

chapters.title: Kids Special
chapters.deck: For the little ones at the table.

items.name: Potato Fries
items.desc: Golden, crisp fries, lightly salted.

items.name: Nuggets and Chips
items.desc: Crumbed chicken nuggets with crisp chips.

chapters.title: Dessert
chapters.deck: Something sweet to close the evening.

items.name: Gulab Jamun
items.desc: Soft milk dumplings fried golden and soaked in warm rose and cardamom syrup.

items.name: Rasmalai
items.desc: Delicate cheese patties in chilled saffron milk with pistachio. Cool, creamy and fragrant.

items.name: Ice Cream
items.desc: A scoop of something cold to finish.

chapters.title: Drinks
chapters.deck: Lassi in tall glasses, and chai the way it should be.

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.desc: Thick, chilled yoghurt blended with ripe mango. Sweet, cool and golden.

items.name: Sweet Lassi
items.desc: Frothy chilled yoghurt, sweetened. Ask for a spoon of white butter on top, Amritsar-style.

items.name: Salted Lassi
items.desc: Chilled yoghurt with salt and roasted cumin. The perfect partner to spice.

items.name: Masala Chai
items.desc: Strong tea brewed with milk, ginger and cardamom, poured steaming.

items.name: Fresh Lime Soda
items.desc: Fresh lime and fizzing soda. Sharp and thirst-quenching.

items.name: Indian Coffee
items.desc: Frothy, milky coffee, whipped until it foams.

items.name: Black Coffee
items.desc: Hot black coffee.

items.name: Soft Drink
items.desc: Ask for today's selection.

items.name: Bottled Water
items.desc: Still bottled water.
